card.name: Chapter numbers in Bible citations
card.fires_on: The chapter number right after a Bible book name in a scripture reference, such as 1 John, Revelation, 1 Tim. or 1 Kings, just before the colon and verse.

modes.label: Chapter after epistle name
modes.description: A single digit chapter number after a numbered New Testament book like 1 John or 1 Peter.

modes.label: Chapter after other book name
modes.description: A chapter number, often the first digit of a multi-digit one, after Revelation or an Old Testament book.

card.plain: It marks the chapter number in a Bible verse reference, just before the colon and verse number.
